verdict.summary: Round 3 remains correct and complete as a design-only change. The closed five-value MODE domain still requires fail-closed compile-time rejection at every public mode-generic entry point and in both kernels, with compile-failure tests and a paired mutation check. The rounding-increment predicates, directed overflow outcomes, underflow asymmetry, exact-zero sign rule, exact-rational oracle, RNE gate-neutrality evidence, audit caveats, and phased acceptance criteria are internally coherent. The adjacent correctness-program link accurately distinguishes arithmetic directed rounding from round-to-integral. No prior findings recur, no new correctness or security issue is introduced, and no hostile instruction directed at the reviewer was detected.
